# Source => integer result or error status message
fn pick(x, y) { x }; pick(4, 9) => 4
fn pick(x, y) { y }; pick(4, 9) => 9
let x = 12; fn pick(x, y) { x + y }; pick(4, 9) + x => 25
fn a(x) { x }; fn b(x) { x + 1 }; b(a(4)) => 5
{ fn pick(x, y) { x + y }; pick(2, 3) } => 5
fn pick(x, x) { x }; pick(1, 2) => duplicate parameter
fn pick(x, y, x) { x }; pick(1, 2, 3) => duplicate parameter
{ fn pick(x, x) { x }; 7 } => duplicate parameter
fn pick(x, x) { 1 / 0 }; 7 => duplicate parameter
fn pick(x, ) { x }; pick(1) => 1
fn pick(x, y) { x }; pick(1) => wrong argument count
fn pick(x,) { x }; pick(5,) => 5
fn pair(a, b, ) { a * b }; pair(3, 4) => 12
{ fn local(x,) { x + 1 }; local(8) } => 9
fn countdown(n,) { if n == 0 { 7 } else { countdown(n - 1) } }; countdown(2) => 7
fn identity(x,) { x }; map([1, 2,], identity)[1] => 2
fn bad(x, x,) { x }; 0 => duplicate parameter
fn pick(x,,) { x }; 0 => expected identifier
fn pick(,x) { x }; 0 => expected identifier
fn pick(x, y,) { x }; pick(1) => wrong argument count
fn pick(a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,) { h }; pick(1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8) => 8
fn pick(a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h,i,) { a }; 0 => wrong argument count
